title: TrustBound: A Mechanized Note on Payment-Epoch Completeness
abstract: A payment receipt establishes an observed outcome; exact epoch closure also requires complete accounting and exclusion of later effects under earlier authority. This note makes those obligations explicit for request-only agents using a trusted payment service. In a Lean transition model, recording before granting authority and serializing both with an admission fence derive a fixed journal covering effects and remaining rights. Complete source-side discharge establishes future stability; truthful per-identity outcomes additionally establish exact identity-level accounting. A constrained provider model permits unregistered inert objects while mediating every activation. Reproduction checks 14 exported results and rejects eight premise-removal mutations. A finite diagnostic, whose two strong comparator labels share the same fence-and-contiguity acceptance rule, documents the evidence boundary; a small flight–hotel example separates payment closure from commit-time policy and trip usability. The contribution is an auditable assumption contract, a checked construction, and reproducible examples that specialize existing closure and authorization principles to payment epochs.
